dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Smooth, symmetrical 2D parabolic narrowing from the mid-body maximum width toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Localized asymmetrical indentations along the left lateral margin where the body surface meets the water, corresponding to visible skin creases.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey median pixel intensity across the visible dorsal plane, with specular highlights concentrated along the right lateral edge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple vertical, parallel linear rake marks on the mid-left dorsal-lateral surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Deep circular shadow-casting indentation at the blowhole site and three distinct longitudinal creases on the mid-to-posterior left flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Vertical parallel linear marks (rake marks) on the left lateral side.
